disclaimer: Curated notes are not medical advice. Safety tiers describe kitchen mechanism, not a guarantee. Always verify with the restaurant before dining. Cross-check Find Me Gluten Free for high-stakes celiac decisions. Re-verify periodically — dedicated spots close and protocols change.

places.name: TAP
places.allergy_safety_note: 100% gluten-free Brazilian café (tapioca sandwiches, açaí, pão de queijo). Dedicated facility — a top Brickell pick for celiac. Confirm dairy/nut needs with staff.

places.name: Dora's Bakery & Bistro
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated gluten-free bakery & bistro — the local answer for GF Cuban-style breads/pastries. Not a shared kitchen.

places.name: Almotti Gluten Free Italian Delicacies
places.allergy_safety_note: 100% dedicated gluten-free Italian bakery (certified). Pasta, breads, and pastries without shared-kitchen wheat risk. Facility also uses dairy/nuts/eggs — ask if those are your concern.

places.name: Archetti's Boutique Bakery
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated zero-gluten artisan bakery (Upper Buena Vista). Owner-family celiac story; keto/vegan options exist — confirm dairy/nut handling for your need.

places.name: Peek Á Treat
places.allergy_safety_note: 100% gluten-free gelato/ice cream shop next to Archetti's. Designed for dietary restrictions — still ask about dairy and nut flavors.

places.name: Nami Nori
places.allergy_safety_note: Hand-roll sushi treated as a rare dedicated celiac-friendly sushi option in Miami. Confirm soy/sauce protocols — do not assume every add-on is safe.

places.name: Bolay Fresh Bold Kitchen
places.allergy_safety_note: Build-your-own bowls in a dedicated gluten-free kitchen. Strong everyday pick for sensitive diners — confirm other allergens day-of.

places.name: Bolay Fresh Bold Kitchen
places.allergy_safety_note: Same dedicated Bolay concept north of the city. Confirm with staff before ordering.

places.name: Stephanie's Crepes
places.address: 600 NW 1st Ave, MiamiCentral Brightline, Miami, FL 33136
places.allergy_safety_note: Every crêpe made with 100% gluten-free batter (all locations). Brightline MiamiCentral — open to the public. Confirm dairy fillings if needed.

places.name: Stephanie's Crepes
places.allergy_safety_note: Same Stephanie's gluten-free batter concept near Miracle Mile. Dedicated GF batter — still ask about fillings and shared toppings.

places.name: Stephanie's Crepes
places.address: 723 Lincoln Ln S Booth 110, Miami Beach, FL 33139
places.allergy_safety_note: South Beach Stephanie's inside The Lincoln Eatery — 100% gluten-free crêpe batter. Handy near Lincoln Road for a dedicated GF stop.

places.name: Sweet Love Bakery
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated kosher gluten-free bakery (also soy-free / peanut-free; many vegan options). Hollywood / Broward — confirm dairy/nut products day-of.

places.name: Pizza Fusion
places.allergy_safety_note: Strong GF pizza protocols and allergy-aware menu — NOT a dedicated facility. Residual shared-kitchen risk; better for 'GF options' than hyper-sensitive celiac. Confirm the Miami Beach shop is open before you go.

places.name: Burton's Grill & Bar
places.allergy_safety_note: Well-known allergy-trained program (Broward / Plantation). Shared kitchen — not dedicated. Useful when you need trained staff protocols north of Miami-Dade.

places.name: True Food Kitchen
places.allergy_safety_note: Allergy-aware national brand at The Falls (Kendall) with GF-marked plates and vegetarian options. Shared kitchen — confirm cross-contact practices for your need.

places.name: Flower Child
places.allergy_safety_note: Build bowls with GF grains/proteins marked on menu. Shared prep — ask about fryer and sauce cross-contact if highly sensitive.

places.name: Pura Vida
places.allergy_safety_note: Menu flags vegan and gluten-friendly items. Shared café kitchen — good for preference/flex needs; celiac should confirm prep and oats/granola cross-contact.

places.name: Pura Vida
places.allergy_safety_note: Same Pura Vida gluten-friendly / vegan-flagged menu near Mary Brickell Village. Shared kitchen — verify if highly sensitive.

places.name: Fresh Kitchen
places.address: 3201 N Miami Ave Suite 103, Miami, FL 33127
places.allergy_safety_note: Fast-casual bowls frequently cited by Miami celiac community. Treat as strong protocols / verify dedicated claims per location — do not assume every franchise kitchen is identical.

places.name: Taquiza
places.allergy_safety_note: Nixtamal corn tortillas — strong natural GF base. Still a busy shared kitchen; confirm fryers/sauces if highly sensitive.

places.name: Bartaco
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn-tortilla taco concept with allergy-aware national protocols. Shared kitchen — not dedicated.

places.name: Sixty Vines
places.allergy_safety_note: Wine-bar American at Miami Worldcenter with GF pizza/pasta options commonly noted by diners. Shared kitchen — confirm prep for celiac.

places.name: Versailles Restaurant
places.allergy_safety_note: Iconic Cuban — some plates can work gluten-free, but it is a SHARED kitchen with flour everywhere. Call ahead; higher risk for celiac. Traditional Cuban bread/croquetas are wheat — go to Dora's or Almotti for GF versions.

places.name: Mary's Cafe & Coin Laundry
places.allergy_safety_note: 24/7 ventanita useful for late-night context only. Croquettes are floured (NOT GF). Shared kitchen — verify, higher risk.

places.name: Coyo Taco
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn tortillas help many GF diners, but shared kitchen / fryers. Verify sauces and prep — not a dedicated facility.

places.name: My Ceviche
places.allergy_safety_note: Ceviche/seafood bowls are often naturally wheat-light, but shared prep and marinades vary. Ask about crackers, soy, and fryer oil — not a dedicated kitchen. Confirm Brickell is open (South Beach has been under renovation).

places.name: Panther Coffee
places.allergy_safety_note: Coffee shop with plant-milk options. Not an allergy kitchen — ask about milk steamer cross-contact if dairy-allergic.

places.name: Jajaja Mexicana
places.allergy_safety_note: Plant-based Mexican — strong for vegetarian/dairy-free. Shared kitchen; vegan ≠ dedicated gluten-free — confirm tortillas and fryers.
